text.p: Typhoon Violet is a major threat to shipping south and east of Okinawa, Japan. Violet has top winds near 120 mph and is expected to slowly weaken during the next 36 hours, but still remain a powerful storm as it tracks to the northeast, passing about 100-150 miles east of Okinawa. The island will likely see rough surf on northern and eastern shores, along with heavy rain squalls and gusty winds.

Typhoon Tom is mainly a threat to shipping in the open waters of the western Pacific. The storm will track northeastward from its current position near 24n/148e during the next 48 hours while losing tropical characteristics. Tom has top winds near 80 mph but weakening will occur this period.
There are no further statements at this time.
